name: Fabric shaver

lead: A fabric shaver is a small handheld device with a guarded blade that cuts off pills and loose fuzz from sweaters, knits and upholstery.
It is used to restore the clean look of worn knitwear. No research literature was found; it is a practical maintenance tool.

paras: Spinning blades under a mesh guard trim fiber balls from the surface while the guard protects the fabric.
Over-use can thin or hole delicate fabrics, and testing on a hidden area first is commonly advised. It is not intended for skin or body hair. Pills return as the garment is worn.
